label: sec:q-hecke-correspondences-intro
html: Building on the moduli of q-local systems, we construct the q-Hecke operator: a Hecke modification twisted by the Iwahori–Hecke generators \sigma_i. This operator acts on the moduli of G_q-bundles. A q-Hecke eigensheaf diagonalises this action, with eigenvalues landing in the representation ring of the dual group. The rigid fibre functor \tau extracts these eigenvalues as characters, matching the automorphic side to the spectral side in the q-Geometric Langlands correspondence.
